limitations: Finite debug-profile integration and process accounting, not performance or production capacity
Linux RSS counters are approximate; virtual bytes are not resident/committed RAM
Requested Rust heap, process totals, inline App/future and 4MiB thread reservation overlap; do not sum
Individual stack high-water, allocator/native private attribution and kernel socket-buffer actual allocation unmeasured
Ephemeral OSCORE sessions; no flash restart/power-cut or installed-device custody proof
